question_text: Will Multiple teams win the Hyperliquid validator vote for the USDH ticker?
resolution_criteria:
If Multiple teams is selected through the Hyperliquid validator vote to receive the USDH ticker designation before Jan 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
Resolution is based on which team receives the most stake-weighted validator votes during the official voting period. If Hyperliquid Foundation validators abstain and align with the non-Foundation majority, their stake counts toward the team with the most non-Foundation support. If no team receives votes or the vote is cancelled, all markets resolve to No unless "None/No team selected" is listed. Ties resolve to No unless Hyperliquid implements an official tiebreaker. Only the initial official announcement determines resolution; subsequent disputes or reversals after expiration do not affect the outcome.
